notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet G/10/484 'Truck engine brake sign G9-101' (scanned sheet, sideways A4). 2000 x 1400, 75 rad, black on Class 1 white; the 45 at the corner = 20 white edge + 25 black border (the P411-1 standard border). Vertical chain 45/95/140/95/140/95/180/95/140/95/140/95/25/20; horizontal figures are measured from inside the border (sums 1910): 230/1451/229, 653/605/652, 248/667/100/646/247, 70/799/100/872/69, truck 522/XXXX (width not stated: 432 measured, 180 high per the chain). 140 Series E Mod throughout (AS 1744 widths about 6% under the sheet's). Black panel behind RESIDENTIAL AREA not dimensioned: measured 1557 x 447 (R40), centred, placed symmetrically about the two lines (36 above / below). G9 family: excluded from generation like the national G9 signs (Russell, 2026-09-05); spec kept.
